function cpf(){const d=Array.from({length:9},()=>Math.floor(Math.random()*10)); if(d.every(n=>n===d[0]))d[8]=(d[8]+1)%10; for(let n=9;n<11;n++){let s=0;for(let i=0;i<n;i++)s+=d[i]*(n+1-i);const r=11-s%11;d.push(r>=10?0:r);}return d.join('');}
